summary: Ping An Biomedical Co., Ltd. filed a Form 6-K disclosing it received a Nasdaq deficiency letter for failing to maintain a minimum $1 bid price per share. The company was granted an additional 180-day compliance period until November 23, 2026, and intends to cure the deficiency via a reverse stock split if necessary. No board recommendation or advisor is named. The filing serves as a notification of potential delisting risk. What to watch: whether the company can sustain a closing bid price of at least $1 for ten consecutive days before the deadline, or if it will implement the reverse split to regain compliance.
